book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.ar: هولمز اشترى آخر تمثال بنفسه ورجع فيه عالبيت.
sentences.en: Holmes bought the last statue himself and brought it home.
He set it on the table before Lestrade and me.
He struck it with the hammer once.

sentences.ar: بين قطع الجبس، كان في لؤلؤة كبيرة.
sentences.en: Among the pieces of plaster was a big pearl.
It was like a pigeon’s egg.
Lestrade was silent a moment and then applauded.
He said: we are proud of you.

sentences.ar: وشفت هولمز يحمر وجهه لأول مرة.
sentences.en: And I saw Holmes blush for the first time.
